evidence: Directly modifies src/index/txindex.*, src/index/base.*, and adds src/index/tx_lookup_result.h to support index pruning policies.
rationale: Lifts the long-standing mutual exclusion between -txindex and -prune, enabling storage-constrained nodes to index transactions without retaining the entire block history on disk. As reviewers noted, this significantly expands the capabilities of pruned nodes.
